top_fixes.rule: Plan/lower instalments/more time requests: describe nothing, `transfer_to_agent` queue `restructuring`, close transferred TRS.
top_fixes.why: If a customer in the hardship node asks for a payment plan, lower instalments or more time, the agent says it cannot offer that. It should transfer to the restructuring queue and close as transferred/TRS, so close_call sends the wrong outcome/reason and the transfer_to_agent call is missing.
top_fixes.fix: hardship node: (1) extraction_schema support_choice: add the enum value "new_plan" with the description "customer asks for a payment plan, lower instalments or more time". (2) Add a transition, before the other support_choice routes: support_choice equals "new_plan" -> xfer_restructuring, which already calls transfer_to_agent with queue "restructuring" and goes to fin_transferred_restructuring (outcome=transferred, reason=TRS). (3) task_message: replace "if they ask for one, say you cannot offer that" with "If they ask for a plan, lower instalments or more time, do not describe any options or terms. Say you will connect them to a colleague who handles this, and transfer them." Check that every other conversation node that can hear this request routes to xfer_restructuring on new_plan the same way negotiate and wrapup already do.
